charts.title: HD 73344 b: orbits around HD 73344
charts.description: The orbits of HD 73344's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 73344 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Sulis et al. 2024 (2024A&A...688A..14S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname SULIS_ET_AL_2024): P 15.611 d

charts.title: HD 73344 b: its transit
charts.description: HD 73344 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (46, 71, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 175193677, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 18 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 20 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 13-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 18 min late; 13-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 7 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
